ElementDescription: The NDAR Global Unique Identifier (GUID) for research subject
Subject ID how it's defined in lab/project
Date on which the interview/genetic test/sampling/imaging/biospecimen was completed. MM/DD/YYYY
Age in months at the time of the interview/test/sampling/imaging.
Notes: Age is rounded to chronological month. If the research participant is 15-days-old at time of interview, the appropriate value would be 0 months. If the participant is 16-days-old, the value would be 1 month.

ElementDescription: Sex of subject at birth
Notes: M = Male; F = Female; O=Other; NR = Not reported

ElementDescription: Timepoint/visit label
Notes: e.g., Baseline, 6-Month Follow Up, Year 2; Morning, At Bedtime

ElementDescription: In the last 7 days, how often have you stopped yourself from having an alcoholic drink because you wanted to cut back?
Notes: 0=Never; 1.5=1-2 times; 3.5=3-4 times; 7=5-9 times; 10=10 or more times

ElementDescription: In the last 7 days, how often have you decided not to finish an alcoholic drink because you wanted to cut back?
Notes: 0=Never; 1.5=1-2 times; 3.5=3-4 times; 7=5-9 times; 10=10 or more times

ElementDescription: In the last 7 days, how often did you choose a smaller size of an alcoholic drink because you wanted to cut back?
Notes: 0=Never; 1.5=1-2 times; 3.5=3-4 times; 7=5-9 times; 10=10 or more times

ElementDescription: In the last 7 days, how often did you choose an alcoholic drink with less alcohol in it because you wanted to cut back?
Notes: 0=Never; 1.5=1-2 times; 3.5=3-4 times; 7=5-9 times; 10=10 or more times

ElementDescription: In the last 7 days, how often did you choose a non-alcoholic drink instead of alcohol because you wanted to cut back?
Notes: 0=Never; 1.5=1-2 times; 3.5=3-4 times; 7=5-9 times; 10=10 or more times

ElementDescription: How interested are you in drinking no more than 14 drinks in the next week?

ElementDescription: How interested are you in drinking no more than 7 drinks in the next week?
Notes: 1=Not at all interested; 2=A little interested; 3=Somewhat interested; 4=Very interested; 5=Extremely interested

ElementDescription: How much do you plan to have no more than 14 drinks in the next week?
Notes: 1=Not at all; 2=Very little; 3=Somewhat; 4=Quite a bit; 5=A great deal

ElementDescription: How much do you plan to have no more than 7 drinks in the next week?
Notes: 1=Not at all; 2=Very little; 3=Somewhat; 4=Quite a bit; 5=A great deal

ElementDescription: How likely are you to have no more than 14 drinks in the next week?
Notes: 1=Not at all likely; 2=A little likely; 3=Somewhat likely; 4=Very likely; 5=Extremely likely

ElementDescription: How likely are you to have no more than 7 drinks in the next week?
Notes: 1=Not at all likely; 2=A little likely; 3=Somewhat likely; 4=Very likely; 5=Extremely likely
